name: makisend
description: Self-hosted transactional email API on Cloudflare Workers: one POST /send-email, delivered through your own SMTP provider.

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: AES-256 key that encrypts recipients, bodies and SMTP credentials in D1: 64 hex characters, generate it with `openssl rand -hex 32`. **Keep a copy**: data encrypted with a lost key cannot be read again.

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: Signs dashboard sessions and encrypts the two-factor secrets. A long random string, e.g. `openssl rand -base64 32`.

MAKISEND_REPOSITORY.description: Optional. The GitHub repository this install was copied to, as `owner/name` (the one created by this set-up). The dashboard's **Update** button then opens its *Sync with upstream* workflow.

UPDATE_CHECK.description: Checks once a day whether a newer MakiSend release is published on GitHub and shows it on the dashboard. Set to `off` to never contact GitHub.

scripts.docker:test: docker compose run --rm backend pnpm test:run
scripts.docker:lint: docker compose run --rm backend pnpm lint
scripts.docker:migrate: docker compose run --rm backend pnpm exec wrangler d1 migrations apply makisend_db --local
